daily.brief: 過去約31小時半（11日11:30至12日19:04）有175則帖、68個帳號。共同看好集中在$AMD（6個帳號）同$GOOGL（2個帳號），主要因為Nvidia領導層可能出現真空。分歧最明顯在$NVDA（7看好對7看淡）同$MU。最大變化係黃仁勳涉及與Kimberly Powell的第二段關係傳聞，盤後$NVDA跌8%，本周市值損失約6000億美元，帶動AMD受惠討論。
daily.full:
共識

共同看好主要在$AMD同$GOOGL。@wallstengine 指出William Blair將$AMD上調至Outperform，理由是Nvidia潛在的領導真空，預期AMD營收在2027年增長超過80%，數據中心AI營收將在第四季超越其伺服器CPU業務（原帖）。@EliteOptions2 分享交易計劃，關注Jensen辭職官方新聞，可能使$NVDA再跌至153，$AMD盤後升25+，目標AMD將至600（原帖）。@Frenchie_ 詳述醜聞同Bernstein將倍數與目標價從400美元下調的討論（原帖）。$GOOGL方面，@OpenOutcrier 引用研究探討Nvidia領導危機如何推動主要AI客戶轉向Google較低成本方案（原帖），@Mr_Derivatives 則指$GOOGL現在接近超越$NVDA成為世界第三大公司（原帖）。

共同看淡

今日無共同看淡。bear列表為空，看淡觀點未形成多帳號共識。

分歧

$NVDA是最大分歧，7個帳號看好對7個看淡，103則提及。@Mr_Derivatives 認為玩笑話不談，終究仍需要GPU來推動這場AI革命，$NVDA最終會走出這個困境（原帖）。@aleabitoreddit 不同意，指Jensen Huang對$NVDA幾乎不可替代，就像從$TSLA拿掉Elon，估值與信心會崩潰（原帖）。@daniel_koss 分析董事會，11人移除他需要6票，認為董事會清楚知道保留黃仁勳符合Nvidia經濟利益（原帖）。$MU也有分歧，@TradexWhisperer 指出3天內從667美元升至828美元約24%（原帖），@themissinglinks 視記憶體股為線索，@Frenchie_ 則從醜聞角度看淡相關。

其他值得留意

最多人講的是$NVDA（103提及、42帳號），其次$AMD（11提及、9帳號）。討論幾乎全圍繞領導層不確定性同誰會受惠。

weekly.brief: 過去7日（06日至12日）有347則帖、97個帳號。共同看好包括$AMD（8個帳號）、$GOOGL（3個帳號）、$APP（3個帳號）等14隻。共同看淡列表為空。分歧最深在$NVDA、$MU同指數相關。最大變化係AI基建同部分應用層繼續有共識，而領導層傳聞加劇個別名字波動。
weekly.full:
共識

共同看好有14隻，最穩包括$AMD、$GOOGL、$APP、$SPCX、$AVGO。@Mr_Derivatives 提到$APP過去5天從谷底到峰頂+72%（原帖）。@OptionsMike 認為$AMZN拋售過度，是超大規模雲端中最佳，高於所有均線，272.5歷史高點在望，自己從未賣出仍持有（原帖）。@EliteOptions2 指出上週四的拋售標誌底部，$SPX反彈近200點，$QQQ上漲25點以上，目標包括SPX至7620（原帖）。@StockSavvyShay 多次將多隻名字放入智能體AI經濟四層結構。

共同看淡

本週無共同看淡。bear列表為空。

分歧

$NVDA、$MU、$NBIS、$QQQ、$SPY 等有明顯分歧。$NVDA有帳號認為最終會走出困境需要GPU（@Mr_Derivatives），亦有認為黃仁勳幾乎不可替代（@aleabitoreddit）。指數方面有反彈目標，亦有看淡聲音如@KeithMcCullough 再次做空$QQQ。$TSLA 有帳號指過去5年持有虧損了2%。

其他值得留意

347帖中，AI相關基建同應用層有較乾淨共識，指數同部分記憶體則分歧明顯。272.5是明確提到的$AMZN價位，SPX 7620是另一個目標。

monthly.full:
共識

共同看好有71隻，最穩包括$AMD、$SOFI、$SKHY、$RSP。@Jake__Wujastyk 指$SOFI是少數月線蠟燭收盤看起來不錯的之一（原帖）。@OptionsMike 認為$SOFI財報很好，在大幅回落後容易反彈。@wallstengine 同@Frenchie_ 對$AMD的看好理由延續至Nvidia領導真空。名單涵蓋金融、半導體等多個方向。

共同看淡

共同看淡有15隻，最突出$RDDT、$BA、$FTNT。@KobeissiLetter 指$RDDT在8個交易日內下跌42%，AI已經永遠地擾亂了搜索以及更廣泛的互聯網（原帖）。@Mr_Derivatives 提到$BA今天下跌10%，創1.5年新低。

分歧

分歧有113隻，包括$NVDA（17看好對11看淡）、$SPY、$TSLA（21對4）、$SPCX、$CRWV（4對20）。$SPY幾乎完全分裂，$CRWV看淡佔優勢，而$TSLA多空並存。整體分歧數量遠超共同共識，反映28日內市場在不同主題間快速輪動。

其他值得留意

共同看好數量明顯多於共同看淡。總量5688帖說明資訊密度高，方向仍需從個別帳號理由中分辨。272.5繼續是$AMZN相關討論中出現的價位。

今日簡報

過去約31小時半討論集中在Nvidia領導層傳聞。共同看好$AMD（6個帳號）同$GOOGL（2個帳號），@wallstengine 引William Blair上調，@EliteOptions2 目標AMD至600、NVDA可能至153。$NVDA本身7對7分歧，有帳號認為GPU仍必要最終會恢復，亦有認為黃仁勳不可替代。無共同看淡。7日視角顯示$AMD、$APP等有共識，指數分歧；28日則$AMD、$SOFI最穩，$RDDT等看淡，$SPY同$CRWV仍高度分裂。

daily.brief: Over the past ~31.5 hours (11th 11:30 to 12th 19:04) there were 175 posts from 68 accounts. Common bullish views concentrated on $AMD (6 accounts) and $GOOGL (2 accounts), mainly due to potential leadership vacuum at Nvidia. Clearest splits on $NVDA (7 bull vs 7 bear) and $MU. Biggest change is the rumor of Jensen Huang’s second relationship with Kimberly Powell, post-market $NVDA down 8%, weekly market cap loss around $600B, driving AMD beneficiary discussion.
daily.full:
Consensus

Common bullish mainly on $AMD and $GOOGL. @wallstengine notes William Blair upgraded $AMD to Outperform on potential Nvidia leadership vacuum, expecting AMD revenue growth over 80% in 2027 and data center AI revenue surpassing server CPU business in Q4 (post). @EliteOptions2 shares a trading plan watching for official Jensen resignation news, which could send $NVDA down to 153 again, $AMD up 25+ after hours, targeting AMD to 600 (post). @Frenchie_ details the scandal and Bernstein cutting multiple and price target from $400 (post). On $GOOGL, @OpenOutcrier cites research on how Nvidia leadership crisis could push major AI customers toward Google’s lower-cost options (post), while @Mr_Derivatives notes $GOOGL is now close to overtaking $NVDA as the world’s third-largest company (post).

Common Bearish

No common bearish names today. The bear list is empty; bearish views have not formed multi-account consensus.

Divergence

$NVDA is the biggest split, 7 bull accounts vs 7 bear, 103 mentions. @Mr_Derivatives says jokes aside, GPUs are still needed to drive this AI revolution and $NVDA will eventually get through this (post). @aleabitoreddit disagrees, arguing Jensen Huang is almost irreplaceable for $NVDA, like removing Elon from $TSLA would collapse valuation and confidence (post). @daniel_koss analyzes the board: 11 members need 6 votes to remove him, and the board knows keeping Huang is in Nvidia’s economic interest (post). $MU also splits, with @TradexWhisperer noting the move from $667 to $828 in 3 days, about 24% (post), @themissinglinks treating memory as a clue, and @Frenchie_ viewing related names through the scandal lens.

Other Notes

Most discussed is $NVDA (103 mentions, 42 accounts), followed by $AMD (11 mentions, 9 accounts). Discussion almost entirely centers on leadership uncertainty and who benefits.

14 common-bullish names, steadiest including $AMD, $GOOGL, $APP, $SPCX, $AVGO. @Mr_Derivatives notes $APP up 72% from trough to peak over 5 days (post). @OptionsMike sees the $AMZN selloff as overdone, best among hyperscalers, above all moving averages, with the 272.5 historical high in sight, and has never sold and still holds (post). @EliteOptions2 sees last Thursday’s selloff as marking the bottom, $SPX rebound nearly 200 points, $QQQ up over 25 points, targets including SPX to 7620 (post). @StockSavvyShay repeatedly places multiple names into the four-layer agentic AI economy.

Common Bearish

No common bearish names this week. The bear list is empty.

Divergence

$NVDA, $MU, $NBIS, $QQQ, $SPY and others show clear splits. $NVDA has accounts saying it will eventually get through needing GPUs (@Mr_Derivatives), and others arguing Huang is almost irreplaceable (@aleabitoreddit). On indices there are rebound targets alongside bearish views such as @KeithMcCullough shorting $QQQ again. $TSLA has accounts noting 5-year holders are down 2%.

Other Notes

Among 347 posts, AI-related infra and application layers have cleaner consensus while indices and some memory names diverge. 272.5 is an explicit price level for $AMZN, SPX 7620 is another target.

113 split names including $NVDA (17 bull vs 11 bear), $SPY, $TSLA (21 vs 4), $SPCX, $CRWV (4 vs 20). $SPY is nearly even, $CRWV heavily bearish, $TSLA mixed. With splits far outnumbering one-sided consensus, the 28-day period shows rapid rotation across themes.

Other Notes

Common-bullish names clearly outnumber common-bearish. Total volume of 5688 posts indicates high information density, but direction still needs to be read from individual account reasons. 272.5 continues to appear in $AMZN-related discussion.

Today’s Briefing

Discussion over the past ~31.5 hours centered on Nvidia leadership rumors. Common bullish on $AMD (6 accounts) and $GOOGL (2 accounts), with @wallstengine citing the William Blair upgrade and @EliteOptions2 targeting AMD to 600 and NVDA possibly to 153. $NVDA itself is 7-vs-7 split: some say GPUs remain essential and it will recover, others argue Huang is irreplaceable.
